name: task-orchestrator-mod
description: Opt-in Claude Code mod for MCP Task Orchestrator: live work graph, gate band, and in-process orchestration hooks (early-access function-hooks API)

cellWidthPx.title: Graph cell width (px)
cellWidthPx.description: Width of one character cell in the desktop /to-graph pane; aligns the edge layer with the boxes.

cellHeightPx.title: Graph cell height (px)
cellHeightPx.description: Height of one character cell in the desktop /to-graph pane.

graphToasts.title: Work graph toasts
graphToasts.description: Show a toast when a graph item completes, becomes ready, is sent back from review to work, or one of this session's advances is gate-blocked. Off by default.
